celebration.title: Armed Forces Day
celebration.description: Armed Forces Day is annually observed in Bangladesh on 21 November, signifying formation of Bangladesh Armed Forces on the day in 1971, when the members of the Bangladesh Army, Navy and Air Force were officially unified under and launched joint operations against the Pakistan Armed Forces in the Bangladesh Liberation War. On 16 December 1971, the Pakistani Army of 93,000 surrendered to the joint forces of Bangladesh and India, ending the 9-month long Liberation War of Bangladesh.

science.title: Love Canal
science.description: (source) In 1968, Sheri Schroeder was born the third child to Karen Schroeder, who lived beside the Love Canal chemical dump in the city of Niagara Falls, New York. It was the physical problems of her daughter at birth that prompted her mother to learn about the extent of the Love Canal environmental problem. A vigorous campaign brought it to the public's attention. Sheri was born with a heart that beat irregularly and had a hole in it, bone blockages of the nose, partial deafness, deformed ear exteriors, and a cleft palate. From about the late 1930s, the Hooker Company, manufacturer of pesticides, plasticizers, and caustic soda, used the abandoned canal to dump over 20,000 tons of toxic waste residues which leaked into local homes. Love Canal: Science, Politics, and People, by Adeline Gordon Levine. - book suggestion.

fr.title: Love Canal

Ce sont les problèmes physiques de sa fille à la naissance qui ont incité sa mère à se renseigner sur l'ampleur du problème de Love Canal.

it.title: Love Canal
it.description: (fonte) Nel 1968, Sheri Schroeder nacque come terza figlia di Karen Schroeder, che viveva accanto alla discarica chimica di Love Canal nella città di Niagara Falls, nello Stato di New York. Furono i problemi fisici della figlia alla nascita a spingere la madre a informarsi sulla portata del problema della discarica di Love Canal.

ru.title: Лав-Канал
ru.description: (источник) В 1968 году Шери Шредер родилась третьим ребенком у Карен Шредер, которая жила рядом с химической свалкой «Лав-канал» в городе Ниагара-Фолс, штат Нью-Йорк. Именно физические проблемы дочери при рождении побудили ее мать узнать о масштабах проблемы в Лав-Кэнале.

el.title: Love Canal
el.description: (πηγή) Το 1968, η Σέρι Σρόιντερ γεννήθηκε ως το τρίτο παιδί της Κάρεν Σρόιντερ, η οποία ζούσε δίπλα στη χημική χωματερή του Love Canal στην πόλη Νιαγάρα Φολς της Νέας Υόρκης. Ήταν τα σωματικά προβλήματα της κόρης της κατά τη γέννηση που ώθησαν τη μητέρα της να μάθει για την έκταση της μόλυνσης του Love Canal.
